copy.console: Open Google Cloud Console and create (or pick) a project for Correctly.
copy.oauthClient: Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application.
copy.origins: Copy these URLs into the Google console (click to copy).
copy.paste: Paste the Client ID and Client Secret from Google.
copy.test: Try the Google button. If it works, mark the wizard as done.

vapid.title: Wizard · Web Push (VAPID)
vapid.subtitle: Keys so alarms can reach users in the background.
vapid.subject: Subject (mailto:…)
vapid.testOk: Sent to {n} device(s). You should see a notification.
vapid.testFail: Couldn't send. Enable Web Push in Alarms on this device first.

copy.explain: VAPID is Correctly's identity for sending Web Push notifications. Without these keys, browsers won't accept background alerts.
copy.pointPublic: Public key: used by the browser when subscribing (safe to expose).
copy.pointPrivate: Private key: server-only. Don't share it or commit it to Git.
copy.generate: You can generate a key pair here. They're created on the server; save them in the next step.
copy.generateHint: If you regenerate later, users must Enable Web Push again.
copy.paste: Review or paste the keys and save. They're stored in the database (with .env as fallback).
copy.hostinger: Optionally also put them in Hostinger's .env. Not required if you already saved them here.
copy.hostingerOptional: Saving in this wizard is enough for production. .env is only a backup or preference.
copy.test: Enable Web Push in Alarms on this device and send a test. If the notification arrives, mark the wizard done.
copy.test2: Tap Enable Web Push and allow the permission.
copy.test3: Come back here and tap Send test push.
